desc: A shot of Sheldon, seen through the window waving his hands and shooing a bird sitting on the ledge outside the window.
A shot of Sheldon, seen through the window, knocking on the window at a bird sitting on the ledge outside.
Sheldon pulls the cord on the curtains causing the drapes to draw closed.
A shot of Sheldon, seen through the window at night, making cat-like hand gestures at a bird sitting on the ledge outside the window.
Leonard, in a grey suit, flaps his arms like a chicken.
Leonard takes off his grey blazer with angry face and walks out of the room.
Sheldon, standing in front of a bookcase, near the window with drapes, dials a number on his cell phone.
Sheldon, standing in front of a bookcase, near a DNA model, angrily hits the button to hang up the phone.
Leonard, in a blue baseball cap worn backwards, stands in the apartment and throws his hands out from his sides while talking.
Leonard, in a blue baseball cap worn backwards, turns around and, frustrated, takes off his baseball hat while going into the bedroom.
Sheldon, standing near the window and bookcase, twitches and rushes towards the desk to get a pen and paper and suddenly writes something.
Sheldon, seen through the window, tries to scare the bird outside by holding up a drawing of a cat to his face, while making a cat gesture with his hand.
Penny, in a dark grey blazer, and Leonard walk into the movie theater.
Leonard walks away from Penny, then turns around, while she rummages through her shoulder bag, in the movie theater.
Howard, all in blue, rests his chin on his hand in a armchair, then picks up the remote from the coffee table.
Sheldon, in a yellow shirt, points his finger at his mouth while talking to Raj on the couch.
Sheldon adjusts a machine standing at the desk near the window and bookcase, while looking at it.
Sheldon, Raj, and Howard stand by the window at night as it cracks, with a bird still on the ledge.
Sheldon, Raj, and Howard come and look closer at the cracked window together.
Leonard extends his hand and holds it out in front of him, and Penny, at the bar, gives him something from her purse.
Penny hangs her purse on her chair at the bar and elbows a nearby man with a laptop.
Leonard stands by Penny's table at the bar, then sets the table number down.
Sheldon opens the cracked window and, when he sees a bird on the sill, closes it quickly.
Sheldon goes out of the closet with a helmet on his head and holding a broom.
Sheldon, with a helmet on his head and holding a broom, opens the cracked window and leans over.
The bird flies into the apartment through the open window.
Sheldon gets up from the floor and takes off his helmet, seeing a bird sitting on the sofa in the apartment.
Leonard and Penny, in a dark grey blazer, both stand with crossed arms in the crowded bar.
Amy and Bernadette look at a bird on the couch, then turn to Sheldon standing in the doorway with crossed arms.
Amy opens the door wider where Sheldon stands and the bird hops on the back of the sofa.
Bernadette walks over to the couch and lets a bird jump on her arm.
Sheldon slowly walks from doorway toward a bird that Bernadette is holding on her arm, to pet it.
Sheldon touches the feathers of a bird slight then jumps back with a smile.
Bernadette is holding a bird on her arm, looking angrily at Sheldon in a yellow shirt.
Sheldon, with a bird on his arm, picks up a cup from a table near the sofa and offers it to the bird, who takes it.
Bernadette walks towards Sheldon, who is seated on the couch with a bird on his arm, and takes his picture.
Sheldon opens the cracked window and the bird flies away through it, from the couch.
